mentions.name: Personal site/blog revamp
mentions.description: This personal website/blog is being refreshed with improved contrast and more uniform color usage, replaces categories with tags so related content can be easily linked and searched, and may add WebMentions support to serve as a comment section.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making some minor changes to my personal site/blog to improve contrast, have a more uniform usage of colours throughout, and also replacing "categories" with tags so that I can have related content easily linked and searchable.

I may also finally finish implementing WebMentions support too as a kind of comment section.
